plantilla.aviso_no_oficial: Independent, unofficial website made by a family that uses the Tarjeta Familia. Official information is only published in Spanish.
plantilla.pie_nota: Independent website, not affiliated with the Regional Government of Castilla y León (Junta de Castilla y León), CaixaBank or MoneyToPay. The content is based on public documents from the Regional Ministry for Families (Consejería de Desregulación, Familia y Ayudas Sociales). If in doubt, the official information prevails
